result.rationale: The migration does `val.split("\n")` and inserts hosts verbatim via raw SQL INSERT, never invoking the model's before_validation that strips 'http://' / paths. EmbeddableHost.record_for_host then compares `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against the referer's URI host, so a previously-valid setting entry like 'http://eviltrout.com' migrates as 'http://eviltrout.com' and will never match 'eviltrout.com', silently breaking embedding for those hosts (the old SiteSetting logic stripped the protocol).

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill copies each line from the old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` into the new `embeddable_hosts.host` column using raw SQL (`execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`). This bypasses `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping `http://`, `https://`, and paths). Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` parses the URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, which will not match rows stored as `http://eviltrout.com` or `https://example.com/1234`. So previously-accepted prefixed/URL-form entries can become non-matching after migration, breaking `host_allowed?` checks in `EmbedController`/`TopicRetriever`.
